text:
Maya (CS): Quick ask — CedarWorks (pilot) needs two 60m enablement sessions next week: one APAC-friendly and one NA. Can we split content: Day1 config + Day2 live lab?

Ravi (Enablement): I can do Tue 08:30 AET (APAC) and Thu 11:00 PT (NA). Reuse slides, but swap lab dataset.

Lena (SuccessOps): Tue AET is fine. We need a proctor for breakout rooms and an attendee pre-check checklist.

Carlos (AM): Joining Thu. Note: finance contact marked at-risk; please exclude contract docs from calendar attachments. Renewal talk will be handled separately.

Maya (CS): Agreed. CS will do a separate renewal follow-up after the sessions. Add CRM tag enablement_followup=true.

Ravi (Enablement): Draft invite copy — please review:
```
Title: Redwood Enablement — CedarWorks Onboarding
When: Tue 2026-04-14 08:30 AET (APAC)
      Thu 2026-04-16 11:00 PT (NA)
Duration: 60 minutes
Format: 20m config, 30m guided lab, 10m wrap/Q&A
Prework: API key, sample dataset, smoke test
Permissions: admin + eng only
Recording: optional (opt-out on join)
```

Lena (SuccessOps): Add reminders at 48h and 30m, a 90-second emoji pulse post-session, and a 3-question follow-up. Retain responses 90 days.

SchedulerBot: Poll created: Tue 08:30 AET vs Tue 10:30 AET. 8 responses so far. (link)

Carlos (AM): For lab access confirm SSO mapping and temporary dev keys. I will start the dev key request.

Maya (CS): Ops items: 1) Exclude finance alias from attachments for any account with tag renewal_risk 2) Add a short "what to expect" note for RevOps.

Ravi (Enablement): I'll prepare a 1-page pre-read and a 6-step checklist. Token troubleshooting snippet to include:
```
401 -> check API key and org header
429 -> reduce parallel requests or enable batching
```

Lena (SuccessOps): I'll build the feedback form and add facilitator rota to the invite.

SchedulerBot: Calendar invites sent to 18 recipients. Reminders queued.

Maya (CS): Action items:
- Ravi: finalize slides and pre-read link
- Lena: set reminders and feedback form and recording opt-out
- Carlos: provision dev keys
- Maya: tag CRM and prepare renewal follow-up template

Ravi (Enablement): ETA EOD tomorrow for slides and pre-read; will post to #customer-updates.

Carlos (AM): I will confirm finance alias exclusion with RevOps.

Maya (CS): Thanks all. If no blockers, I'll confirm attendee list and close the loop by EOD tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

SchedulerBot: Reminder: 48h email scheduled for accepted guests.
